craft_notes: Sthāyin: the final seal — Parama-Siva through crossed recognitions. Sanskrit-first: janottīrṇa-prasiddhi-rūḍhaḥ kept compound (established-through-recognitions-crossed); paramaśivaḥ kept as the last word of the āhnika. Rows: 1 ('through the crossed recognitions' closes — prasiddhi-series named last), 9 (then/becomes verdict), 12 (whole-unit śānta-fall into the Lord's name). Close: 'through the crossed recognitions.' Rejected: putting Parama-Siva first — killed: the name is the destination, destinations end lines; 'fully established' — killed: janottīrṇa keeps the crossing (recognitions traversed, not erased).

reads_against.argmap: What does the āhnika close with? → Closing seal: paramaśivatva achieved once the recognitions are crossed — the prasiddhi-series ends in the Lord.
c1_essence: Then Parama-Siva, established through crossed recognitions.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of authority established (wonder settling into doctrinal calm)
